## 🎯 Problem Statement
A clear description of what problem this feature would solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you'd like to see implemented.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## 📸 Mockups / References
If applicable, add mockups, screenshots of similar features in other apps, or visual references.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context about the feature request here.

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I've checked the existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] This feature doesn't require access to user data (NeoTiler is privacy-first)
